example_sentences_in_bangla: আকাশে ঘনঘটা পড়েছে, বৃষ্টি হবে বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
গ্রীষ্মের দুপুরে ঘনঘটা ছাড়া আর কোনো আশ্রয় নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: A dense canopy of clouds has formed in the sky, suggesting rain is coming.
In the summer afternoon, there's no shelter except the dense cloud cover.
note: This idiom draws from natural observations in Bengali rural life, often used in literature to describe overcast skies.
